source: docs/specs/group-collections.md (Funding a payment); Developer Notes node 14024:474; frames in sections 13961:399, 13982:78, 13956:56, 13956:101, 13952:57, 13996:199, 13973:78, 14004:320, 14012:375; 2026-11-19
note: Amounts are integer fiat micros (1e-6 of the request currency's major unit). fee = round(x * bps / 10000), gross_up = round(n / (1 - bps / 10000)), both half-up on micros. A balance under dust_floor_micros (half the minor unit) never funds. Funding order: selected, Dollars, others by balance ascending then id. legs, and the modal fee, describe the plan after any top-up. Display strings are the en-US English baseline in USD; Android says Google Pay where these say Apple Pay.

cases.name: s1-no-balance
cases.note: No balance at all. The top-up is the whole amount, above the minimum.
divergences: 1.1 goes straight to Apple Pay from a 'Pay $10.00' button with no modal and no 'Short' line, and 1.2's sheet label is blank; this model gives 'Add $10.00 and Pay $10.00' and 'You’re $10.00 Short'. Open with design.

cases.name: s2-min-top-up
cases.note: Zero Dollars, amount under the minimum: add $5.00, pay $2.00, $3.00 stays in Dollars.
divergences: 2.1 has no payment modal, so no 'Short' line is drawn; the request screen's button carries the add copy.

cases.name: s3-sufficient-dollars
cases.note: Dollars cover it; no conversion, no fee line.

cases.name: s4-add-then-pay
cases.note: Dollars $6.00 is $4.00 short; the $5.00 minimum leaves $1.00 of the top-up unused.

cases.name: s5-s6-convert-shortfall
cases.note: Dollars first, then only the $2.00 still needed is sold from Jeffy. Jeffy $6.00 is the balance section 6 implies.

cases.name: s6-pay-in-jeffy
cases.note: Same wallet, Jeffy selected: Jeffy first, then Dollars convert into Jeffy for free.

cases.name: s7-short-under-min
cases.note: Fitted wallet for section 7 alone: 11 - 6 - 0.99 x 2.99 = 2.0399, short $2.04. The $5.00 top-up makes Dollars $11.00, so nothing converts and Jeffy is untouched.

cases.name: s8-short-over-min
cases.note: Fitted wallet for section 8 alone: Jeffy + Dollars = 5.01 and an undrawn third currency Other = 3.99; 21 - 5.01 - 0.99 x 3.99 = 12.0399, short $12.04, top-up $12.04. Other is then sold partly, fee ~$0.04. Does not share a wallet with section 7.

cases.name: s9-many-small-balances
cases.note: Zero Dollars and 29 community balances. Smallest first: Jeffy 29 up to Jeffy 2 drain, Jeffy 1 (balance not drawn, $1.00 here) is sold for the rest. Display runs largest first.
divergences: 9.3 draws the total as 'Total Used' '~$10.10' (clipped); this model gives 'Total' '$10.10' as 5.3, 6.5 and 7.3 do. Open with design.

cases.name: exact-dollars
cases.note: Dollars equal the amount; the Jeffy balance is never touched.

cases.name: exact-drain
cases.note: Jeffy's spendable value is exactly what is left: 2.020202 - fee 0.020202 = 2.000000.

cases.name: one-micro-short
cases.note: One micro less than exact-drain. Short by a micro, shown as $0.01, top-up $5.00, and the replan needs no conversion.

cases.name: zero-balance-amount-at-min
cases.note: No balances; the amount equals the minimum.

cases.name: sub-cent-fee
cases.note: Selling $0.303030 costs $0.003030, shown as <$0.01.

cases.name: exact-cent-fee
cases.note: Selling $4.00 costs exactly $0.04, so no '~'.

cases.name: half-cent-tie-leg
cases.note: The leg's fee is exactly $0.005 and rounds half-up to ~$0.01. The Dollars row ($9.505) and the total ($10.005) are ties too.

cases.name: half-cent-tie-combined
cases.note: Two legs at $0.0025 each: each row shows <$0.01, the combined $0.005 rounds to ~$0.01.

cases.name: selected-zero-balance
cases.note: Last paid in Jeffy, which is now empty. Jeffy stays selected; Dollars convert into it free, then Other is sold for the rest.

cases.name: selected-zero-no-funds
cases.note: Last paid in Jeffy, nothing held. Top up the amount, then Dollars convert into Jeffy free.

cases.name: last-paid-not-held
cases.note: Last paid in a currency no longer in the wallet. It stays selected and Dollars convert into it.

cases.name: user-choice-over-last-paid
cases.note: The user picked Dollars after the default (last paid Jeffy) was shown.

cases.name: equal-balances-by-id
cases.note: Three equal balances fund in id order: alpha and bravo drain, charlie is sold partly.

cases.name: smallest-first-skips-largest
cases.note: Small drains, Mid is sold partly, Big is never touched.

cases.name: top-up-exact-cents
cases.note: No balances, an amount above the minimum with odd cents.

cases.name: top-up-ceil-sub-cent
cases.note: Short by $6.7033; the top-up rounds up to $6.71, and Jeffy is then sold partly.

cases.name: top-up-shrinks-conversion
cases.note: Before the top-up Jeffy would drain ($8.00, fee $0.08). With $5.00 added only $5.050505 is sold, so the modal shows ~$0.05 from the post-top-up plan.

cases.name: top-up-selected-community
cases.note: Paying in Jeffy: Jeffy, then Dollars (balance and top-up) convert into Jeffy free; Other is never sold.

cases.name: pool-fee-250-bps
cases.note: A pool that declares 250 bps: $2.051282 sold for $2.00.

cases.name: pool-fee-0-bps
cases.note: A pool that declares 0 bps: a conversion with no fee.

cases.name: non-cent-balance-drain
cases.note: Jeffy $2.993417 drains (fee $0.029934), then Other is sold for the last $0.036517: gross $0.036886, fee $0.000369.

cases.name: non-cent-balance-partial
cases.note: Jeffy $2.993417 is sold partly: $2.525253, fee $0.025253.

cases.name: half-micro-fee-drain
cases.note: Jeffy's fee is a half-micro tie: 1% of $2.993450 is $0.0299345, rounded up to $0.029935, so Jeffy delivers exactly the $2.963515 still needed and drains. round(b x 0.99) gives $2.963516, and a partial sale of gross_up($2.963515) = $2.993449 would sell a micro less.

cases.name: dust-skipped
cases.note: Crumb $0.004999 would display as $0.00, so it is dust: no leg and no row, though it is the smallest balance. Jeffy is sold for the $2.00 as in s5-s6-convert-shortfall.

cases.name: dust-and-short-balance
cases.note: Crumb $0.003 is dust and Jeffy $2.999999 spends $2.969999, so the shortfall is $7.030001: short $7.04, top-up $7.04, Jeffy sold partly. Counting Crumb's $0.00297 would give $7.03.

cases.name: half-cent-not-dust
cases.note: Crumb is exactly $0.005, half a cent, which displays as $0.01, so it funds: it drains first (fee $0.00005), then Jeffy is sold for the last $0.00505.

cases.name: dust-paying-and-dollars
cases.note: Last paid in Jeffy, which holds $0.002, and Dollars hold $0.004: both dust. Jeffy stays selected with no Jeffy leg, the shortfall is the whole $2.00, and the Dollars row shows only the top-up, with no '$0.00 from balance'.
